description: Report what okgate is guarding right now: the policy file it loaded (or that none was found), dry-run or enforce mode, each upstream MCP server and whether it connected, a run's cap usage and remaining budget, the kill switch, and pending approvals. Call it first to learn whether okgate is set up; next_step says what to do when it is not. For what a run did, use okgate_get_report; to check the log was not edited, okgate_verify_audit_log. Reads local files only and changes nothing.

run_id.description: Run to read, as it appears in the audit log (for example run_20261007093015_ab12, or the X-Run-Id an HTTP client sent). Omit it for the most recent run.

name: okgate_get_status

audit_log.description: where every tool call is recorded

entries.description: entries in it; 0 when it does not exist yet

path.description: absolute path of the hash-chained JSONL audit log

caps.description: limits from the policy; a counter that is absent has no cap

per_day.description: counter name (tool_calls, writes, deletes, emails, spend_usd or a custom one) → value

per_run.description: counter name (tool_calls, writes, deletes, emails, spend_usd or a custom one) → value

configured.description: true when a policy file was found and loaded; false means okgate guards nothing

on.description: true halts every tool call with KILLED

mode.description: dry-run fakes writes and spends and records them; enforce lets allowed calls run

next_step.description: the one thing to do next, with the command when there is one

pending_approvals.description: destructive calls waiting for a human decision

policy_path.description: absolute path of the policy file read, or looked for

remaining.description: budget left per capped counter, per run and per day

run_id.description: run the usage is for: the requested run_id, else the latest run in the log, else null

upstreams.description: the MCP servers this proxy fronts; empty means none are configured

connected.description: whether okgate is connected to it

used.description: what that run, and today, have used against the caps

per_day.description: counter name (tool_calls, writes, deletes, emails, spend_usd or a custom one) → value

per_run.description: counter name (tool_calls, writes, deletes, emails, spend_usd or a custom one) → value

title: okgate status
